title: Cobblemon additions
description:
A Mod that adds villages with Pokemon Village/City variants - Originally made for the Brocraft server.

This will spawn in a variety of structures within the villages as well. We are planning on adding rare structures!
author: strikebyte
body:
# Brocraft Cobblemon Additions

## Overview

**Brocraft Cobblemon Additions** is a Minecraft Mod that enhances your gameplay experience by replacing the traditional village structures with unique, custom-built structures inspired by the Cobblemon universe. This mod is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing Cobblemon features, providing a fresh take on village exploration.

**SUPPORT AND COMMUNITY DISCORD:** Feel free to join our [discord](https://discord.gg/hJvDaPc39T)! 
  
Annoucements and details for the mod will be posted in our discord!

## Support the Development on Patreon!
If you enjoy this project and want to help support its development, consider becoming a patron! By joining my Patreon, you’ll get access to exclusive content, early releases, and be part of a growing community of dedicated players.

👉 [Join my Patreon here!](https://www.patreon.com/c/Strikebyte)

## Here is a quick glimpse into **Cobblemon Additions** 
I hope you enjoy what you find in your adventures!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/fP062mLAtSA?si=wEDRPXrhvIWFqpSd" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

- **Custom Structures:** Replaces vanilla villages with a variety of custom-designed structures, each contributing to a vibrant game world.
- **Unique Town Centers:** Enjoy specially crafted town centers that serve as focal points for villages, including the **Battlepad** and **The Department store**. (more to come)
- **Diverse Environment:** Explore different themed buildings, including cozy cottages, bustling PokéMarts, and serene retreats.
- **Varied Pathways:** Navigate the world with unique pathways that enhance the aesthetic appeal and functionality of your villages.
- **Dynamic Villager Interaction:** Integrate Cobblemon mechanics with villagers, offering unique interactions and services.

## Installation (For the old datapack versions only)

1. Ensure you have Minecraft with Fabric installed.
2. Download the latest release of **Brocraft Cobblemon Additions** from the releases section.
3. Place the downloaded `.zip` file into the `Datapacks` folder of your Minecraft installation/world.
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## Dependencies

- **Cobblemon version 1.6.1**
- **Waystones**
- Sophisticated Backpacks (Optional)
- Traveler's backpack (Optional)
- Cobblenav (optional)
- **[EMF] Entity Model Features version 2.2.6**(optional - only needed if you use the cobblefolk datapack)
- **[ETF] Entity Texture Features version 6.2.5**(optional - only needed if you use the cobblefolk datapack)


- **it is also recommended that you use the cobblefolk datapack that comes with the cobbletowns mod for the best immersion** (Look on the cobblemon discord in the cobbletowns support channel for the current functioning version)

## Structure Pools

This mod features multiple structure pools, including:

- **Centers:** Custom town center structures.
- **General Structures:** A variety of themed homes and buildings.
- **Paths:** Unique pathways for enhanced navigation.
- **Store Workers:** Villager NPCs for shops and services.
- **General Decor:** Decorative items to enhance the village aesthetics.
- **Lamp Posts:** Functional light sources for your villages.
- **Berries:** Custom berry structures to enrich the environment.

## License

This mod is licensed under the [ARR License](LICENSE).
Do not re-upload this mod

## Acknowledgements

- Special thanks to the creators of Cobblemon and the Minecraft community for their inspiration and support.

versions.changelog:
## What's New in v4.3.0

Requires **Cobblemon 1.7.3+1.21.1** (updated from 1.7.0).

---

### ✨ Fairy Village — New Village Type
A fully realized Fairy-type village has been added with a complete structure set:
- **The Petalwake Pavilion** — large center building
- **Sugarblossom Bakery** — mid-tier community building
- 11 residential structures (Blossomveil Manor, Charmglade House, Glimmerfern Lodge, Honeyblush Haven, Luminelle Cottage, Moonpetal Cottage, Pixie Lantern House, Rosequartz Retreat, Starbloom Residence, Sylveon's Ribbon Rest, Whisperwind House)
- Fairy-specific road paths (straight, curved, T-joint, crossroads)
- Biome tag support for automatic placement in Fairy-type biomes

### 🧊 Ice Village Overhaul
- Complete restructure of the ice village layout and jigsaw connections
- Ice structures reorganized into a proper `structures/` subdirectory
- Silverpine Lodge updated with NPC support (receptionists)
- Waystone data normalized across ice village structures
- New ice road path set

### 👥 NPC Expansion — Season 1 Players
A large cast of NPCs has been added, all with custom player skins and full Cobblemon dialogue trees:

**Season 1 Player NPCs** (15 players): broconutpie, darkwolverine, dragoon217, fishingninja25, indeanajowns, ironboundjam03, joltthewolf, kaydenbreak, kuyajaedan, sakuyahimevt, strikebyte, teddycheese, terrablast98, xxmoonflowerxx1, and more

**Receptionists**: Nurse Joy (Pokécenter), Silverpine Lodge receptionist (×2 variants), Wyrm's Rest receptionist — all with location-specific dialogue

**Staff NPCs**: fishingninja25, ironboundjam03, kaydenbreak, strikebyte, rhett (architect)

**Patreon NPCs**: dragoon217, kuyajaedan

### 🐴 Decorative Pokémon Spawners
New structure-placed spawners added for horse-type Pokémon:
- Ponyta, Rapidash, Alolan Ponyta, Alolan Rapidash
- Blitzle, Zebstrika
- Mudbray, Mudsdale

### 🔧 Structure Fixes
- Painting offsets corrected across multiple structures (dark, default, ice, fighting biomes)
- Waystone origin data normalized to `dungeon` across Pokécenter, Silverpine Lodge, and Wyrm's Rest
- Various minor structural fixes in the Dark Marshlight Tavern, The Crypt, Academy, Department Store, The Lodge, Pokémart, and fighting center
- Road extension improvements for default villages

### 🗑️ Removals
- **PokemonTrialSpawnerBlock and PokemonSpawnerBlock** removed — superseded by Cobblemon's native spawner system
- Legacy/unused code cleaned up (ChunkGeneratorMixin, ShopkeepBlock, LocateCommandMixin, and others)

### 🛠️ Developer / Infrastructure
- NBT Scanner and Painting Offset Fixer tools added for structure maintenance
- CI/CD: release workflow, PR checks, and build validation tasks added
- Unit test coverage added for config and structure layout validation
- License updated to All Rights Reserved (ARR)

---

**Minecraft**: 1.21.1 | **Fabric Loader**: ≥ 0.16.14 | **Cobblemon**: 1.7.3+1.21.1

versions.name: ❄️ Brocraft Cobblemon Additions — Ice Village Update ❄️
versions.changelog:
**Minecraft 1.21.1 | Fabric | Cobblemon 1.7.1+**

The next major BCA update is here, and it’s a **big one**.  
This release introduces the **first fully biome-specific village set**, expands NPC systems, and adds a brand-new way Pokémon appear in the world — all backed by major under-the-hood tooling improvements.

---

## 🏔️ NEW: Ice-Type Villages
BCA now features **custom Ice biome villages**, built from the ground up to feel distinct, immersive, and alive.

### ❄️ What’s Included
- **Complete Ice Village generation system**
  - Small / Mid / Large variants
  - Custom worldgen pools
- **12+ unique Ice-themed structures**, including:
  - 🏔️ **Arctic Timber Haven**
  - 🏡 **Blizzard Bluff Cabin**
  - 🔨 **Frost Forge Cabin**
  - 🏨 **New Ice Lodge**
  - ⛸️ **Ice Skating Rink**
  - 🧊 **Igloo PokéCenter**
- Ice-adapted **paths, décor, and one-off buildings**
- Updated **village Pokémon spawn pools** for cold biomes

These villages are not reskins — they’re a **fully separate biome identity** and set the foundation for future biome-specific expansions.

---

## 👥 NPC SYSTEM — NOW LIVE
NPCs are officially entering the world of BCA.

### 🩺 Nurse Joy (First Major NPC)
- Fully modeled and textured
- Custom dialogue interactions
- Appears naturally within appropriate structures

### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Additional NPCs
- Staff & patron NPCs have been added as part of the system rollout
- Includes:
  - Custom textures
  - Shared animation system
  - “Look Around” idle behavior
  - Dialogue system examples

> As future updates roll out, **you’ll encounter more NPCs naturally** throughout villages and structures.

---

## 🎮 NEW FEATURE: DecoMon
The world is getting more alive.

**DecoMon** are Pokémon that:
- Belong to *other people* (NPC-owned or ambient)
- Do **not** behave like wild encounters
- Can be **scanned to register in your Pokédex**
- Exist primarily to add **life, realism, and world flavor**

Examples include Pokémon like **Chansey** or **Happiny** appearing naturally in villages and buildings.

> You’ll be seeing *a lot more* of these over time.

---

## 🐎 Pokémon & Spawn Improvements
- Added **8 new horse-type Pokémon NBTs**, including:
  - Ponyta / Rapidash (Kanto & Alolan)
  - Blitzle / Zebstrika
  - Mudbray / Mudsdale
- Updated **village Pokémon spawn pools**
- Pokémon placement better matches structure context

---

## 🛠️ MAJOR INFRASTRUCTURE UPGRADE (Behind the Scenes)
This update also introduces tooling that massively improves stability and future development.

### 🔍 NBT Scanner & Auto-Fix Tools
- New internal tools to:
  - Scan structure NBTs for corruption
  - Detect missing mod dependencies
  - Automatically fix painting offset issues
- **21+ structures repaired automatically**
- Release builds now **fail safely** if broken NBTs are detected

➡️ This means **fewer broken structures, fewer crashes, and cleaner releases** going forward.

---

## 🎁 Loot & Gameplay Fixes
- Fixed undamageable tools incorrectly taking damage
- Cleaned up loot table scaling logic
- Minor fixes across tool and village loot pools
- Refactored loot scaling code to avoid obfuscation issues

---

## 📚 Content & Data Additions
- **Complete Pokédex entries book**
  - 16,000+ lines of structured Pokémon data
- Language file updates (`en_us.json`)
- Expanded data consistency across systems
- Book world injection still to come
---

## ⚙️ Technical & Build Updates
- Updated to **Cobblemon 1.7.1+ (MC 1.21.1)**
- Added automated **GitHub release workflow**
- NBT validation now runs **before every release**
- Reduced console noise from experimental warnings

---

## 📋 Full Changelog Summary
**Since Commit: Painting Resize (07fa6b9)**

- 111 files changed  
- +19,973 / -144 lines  
- 24 commits (5 merged PRs)  
- New biome-specific villages  
- NPC system foundation added  
- DecoMon introduced  
- NBT tooling & release validation implemented  

---

## 🔮 What This Update Means
This release lays the groundwork for:
- More biome-specific villages
- Expanded NPC roles and

# **BCA v4.1.4 – Fighting Biomes Update!**  

Hello Trainers!

Version **4.1.4** is now ready — the next biome-specific update in our type-themed release cycle! This update focuses on **Fighting-type Pokémon**, delivering new structures, new workers, visual enhancements, and long-requested quality-of-life additions.

This update introduces brand-new Fighting-aligned village variants across the following biomes:

- **Sunflower Plains**  
- **Plains**  
- **Savanna**  
- **Meadow**  
- **Savanna Plateau**

These bring new designs, layouts, decorations, and structural themes tied to the Fighting aesthetic.

---

## **New in v4.1.4**

### **Custom Paintings**
A full set of custom BCA-themed paintings has been added to enrich builds and structures.

### **Full Loot Table Rework**
We’ve completely rebuilt the loot tables across all structures — improving balance, variety, and mod-integration support.  
This rework also includes:
- Fixes for **missing loot tables**
- Better item variety based on structure type
- Cleaner fallback behavior for optional mod items

### **Currency Exchange Worker**
A brand-new NPC worker now appears in updated settlements, allowing players to exchange currencies directly in-game. Perfect for Cobbledollars and upcoming economic systems.

### **New Farmers Market Store Workers**
The farmers market has been refreshed with updated workers, better structure integration, and more thematic personalities for each stall.

### **Pokémon Spawn Integration in Custom Structures**
Custom structures will now correctly **reflect Cobblemon’s spawn rules**, meaning:
- Pokémon that match the biome and structure theme can spawn naturally
- Improved thematic consistency (Fighting villages → Fighting-adjacent Pokémon, etc.)
- Better synergy with Cobblemon’s own world-gen systems

---

## **Next Update: Winter / Christmas Release**
We’re already preparing the seasonal **Winter Update**, featuring snowy biome expansions, holiday touches, and further biome-specific progress.

- **Patron Release:** As soon as it’s ready  
- **Public Release:** **December 23rd**

---

## **Support the Project**
Want to support development, get early access, and help shape future updates?  
Join the Patreon here:  
 **https://www.patreon.com/strikebyte**

---

## **Thank You!**
Thank you to our amazing Patrons and supporters — your feedback, encouragement, and excitement make all of this possible.  
Even bigger updates, gym systems, and legendary structures are on the way!

— **The BCA Team**

# 🎃 Brocraft Cobblemon Additions v4.0.0 – Changelog

## ✨ Overview
The **Halloween Town Update** marks a major milestone for BCA — introducing the **first biome-specific town variation** and the foundation for future biome-based expansions.  
This version brings atmospheric Halloween flair, smoother structure generation, and several important performance and stability improvements.

---

## 🏘️ New Additions

### 🎃 Biome-Specific Towns
- Introduced the **first themed biome variation** — a **Halloween-inspired town** featuring spooky architecture, glowing lanterns, and seasonal decor.  
- This update establishes the **biome variant framework**, allowing future towns to generate uniquely depending on biome type.

### 🧱 Biome Framework Foundation
- Added a modular system to support **biome-specific structure sets**.  
- Enables future updates like *Plains*, *Tundra*, and *Forest* themes with unique designs, NPCs, and loot.

---

## ⚙️ Fixes & Improvements
- 🧩 Optimized **structure generation performance** for smoother worldgen and reduced lag.  
- 🧭 Improved **village pooling and biome-matching logic** for better placement variety.  
- 💡 Fixed **lighting and decorative block inconsistencies** within structures.  
- 🎁 Updated **loot tables** for improved balance and more rewarding exploration.  
- 🧱 General **bug fixes** across structure pools and decorative feature generation.  
- 🧰 Cleaned up **data files and NBT templates** to improve generation speed and maintainability.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility
- ✅ **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 only  
- 🧬 **Cobblemon:** 1.6 and above  
  *(BCA is also being prepared for full Cobblemon 1.7 compatibility upon release)*  
- 🌍 **Biome Support:** Fully compatible with **Terralith**  
- 🎒 Optional Mod Integration (soft fail):
  - Traveler’s Backpack  
  - PokeNav  
  - Waystones  
  - Sophisticated Backpacks  

*(All integrations are optional — no crashes if mods are missing.)*

---

## 🌾 Coming Next
- **The Plains Update** 🌾  
  - Expanding biome-specific towns to open plains regions  
  - Introducing rustic, Brocraft-style architecture and region-based gym foundations

---

## 🧡 Credits
Developed by **Strikebyte**  
Part of the **Brocraft Cobblemon Additions Project**  

Thank you to all patrons and community members who continue to support the project — your feedback makes each update possible!

versions.name: Cobblemon additions 3.9.2 Cobbledollars integration
versions.changelog:
This version is compatible with Cobbledollars! 

📢 **BCA 3.9.2 is LIVE!**

Hello @everyone!

It’s time to officially launch **Brocraft Cobblemon Additions v3.9.2**! 🎉

You might be wondering — why the jump from **3.8.1** straight to **3.9.2**?

That’s because all intermediate builds were seen and tested by our **Patrons** — what you’re getting today is the most stable, cleaned-up version yet, skipping the buggy in-between builds!

---

### 🧩 What's New in 3.9.2?

#### ✅ MOD FORMAT
We’ve officially transitioned from a **datapack to a full mod**!  
No more installation headaches — just drop it into your `mods/` folder and you’re good to go. Updates will be easier from here on out, especially for launcher users.

---

#### 🎁 Custom Loot Pools Introduced!

The first **four themed loot pools** have been added:
- 🥘 `kitchen`
- 🛋️ `sitting_room`
- 🛏️ `bedroom`
- 🪜 `attic`

Expect many more to come in future updates, including:
- 🔧 Workshop loot pool  
- 🌿 Gardener’s loot pool *(potential integration with Farmer’s Delight?)*  
- ⛏️ Toolsmith & Miner loot pools  
- 🧊 Refrigerator loot *(ice, meats, etc.)*  
- 🐣 Easter egg loot *(what will it have? where will it be? 👀)*

---

### 🧪 We Need Your Feedback!

Balancing these loot pools is a HUGE priority — and your input matters.

Please read through the list of notes below and **join the thread attached to this post** to share your own thoughts!

These are my dev notes from testing the loot — what do you agree/disagree with?

```
- Lucky Egg is too common in kitchen chests
- Kitchen loot needs more *usable* food, and less filler
- Random item counts (up to 8) should be added for realism
- Loaded Dice & Metal Coat appear too often in sitting room
- Remove raw meats, use cooked versions
- Add Glowstone Dust & redstone components to attic
- Charcoal too common in kitchen; more coal instead
- Apples (esp. Applin Apples) appear too often
- Bottle o' Enchanting should be common across all loot types
- Add upgrade items for Sophisticated Backpacks
- Warp Scrolls too common — add more Return Scrolls and Warp Dust instead
- Consider integrating Farmer’s Delight for better kitchen loot?
- Regular backpacks show up too often — tone down their frequency
- Held items (type-specific) show up way too much
- Sophisticated backpacks should have their own loot tables
- XP Candies might need rarity tuning (especially M/L/XL)
- Add more redstone parts to attic (repeaters, pistons, etc.)
- Dusk & Quick Balls can be slightly more common
- Lanterns should be more prevalent
```

✅ Let’s shape these loot tables together. I'm watching the thread — I *really* want to polish this system and your insights will directly influence the next patch.

---

### 🎒 Optional Mod Integration!

We now include optional loot for:
- **Sophisticated Backpacks**
- **Traveler’s Backpack**
- **Waystones**

These mods are **fully optional** — if they aren’t installed, nothing breaks. But if they are, you’ll find items from those mods appearing in loot chests! 🔄

---

### 🔮 Sneak Peek Countdown

Remember that post in **#sneak-peeks**?  
🔥 We’re sitting at **51 fire reactions** — once we hit **75**, I’ll post the **first dungeon sneak peek** 👀

Go drop a 🔥 if you haven't yet and help us unlock the next content reveal!

---

## 📝 Changelog: v3.9.2

### ✨ Major Features
- ✅ Full **transition to mod format** (no more datapack installs)
- ✅ Added **4 custom loot pools** (kitchen, bedroom, sitting_room, attic)
- ✅ Integrated optional loot from:
  - Sophisticated Backpacks  
  - Traveler’s Backpack  
  - Waystones  
- ✅ Improved loot detection — no crashes if mods are missing

---

Thank you all again for your continued support and feedback. We’ve got a *lot* coming down the pipeline, and I can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Let’s make something awesome — together. 💪

— *Strikebyte*

# Brocraft Cobblemon Additions – Changelog

## 🟠 Version 3.6 – 4/6/25

### 🚀 Highlights
- 🎉 Reached **250,000 downloads**! Huge thanks to everyone for the support!

---

### 📦 Additions
- 🧰 **Updated Loot Pools**  
  - Rebalanced and refreshed loot across various structures.
  - Better rewards and more consistent item distribution.

- 🔮 **Added CobbleGacha Support**  
  - Gacha items now appear in loot and can be used for randomized rewards. Look for the cobblegacha machines in pokemarts around the world!
  - Adds a fun new way to engage with loot and exploration.

---

### 🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed structural generation issues.
- Resolved several loot table inconsistencies.
- Cleaned up certain interiors and improved trainer spawn behavior.

---

### 🔒 Patreon-Only Content - in the works!
- All **biome-themed updates**, **legendary structures**, and **custom gyms** are exclusive to the **Patreon version** of the datapack.
  - Early access, monthly content drops, and special features await patrons!

versions.name: BCA 3.3 the Big one (for 1.6.1 cobblemon and 1.21.1 minecraft)
versions.changelog:
## 🌍 Village Spawning Improvements
- Villages now **spawn more frequently** and have a **wider variety of sizes**.
- New **/locate commands**:
  - `/locate structure bca:villages` → Finds the nearest village.
  - `/locate structure bca:village/small`
  - `/locate structure bca:village/mid`
  - `/locate structure bca:village/large`

## 🛒 Pokémart Changes
- Every **Pokémart** now spawns **two shopkeepers**:
  - One sells the usual general-use items.
  - The second is a **fully random shopkeeper** for variety.

## 💰 Loot System Update
- **All decor chests now contain loot!** No more empty barrels—expect useful and thematic items.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes & Optimizations
- Various fixes and refinements to improve performance and village structure integrity.

## 📂 Versioning & File Naming Update
- Moving forward, the file name format will be:
BCA-Datapack-{version number}_C{Compatible Cobblemon version}_M{Compatible Minecraft version}.zip

pgsql
Copy
Edit
- Example: `BCA-Datapack-3.3_C1.4.0_M1.21.1.zip`
- On **Modrinth**, only the mod version will be displayed (e.g., `3.2`).

## ⏳ General Edition Update Cycle Change
- This will likely be the **last major update** for the **General Edition** for the next **9-12 months** other than a potential update where we may integrate with cobbledollars.
- Future efforts will be **fully focused on the Patreon Community Edition**.
- The Community Edition will **eventually** be made public once it is stable and complete.

## 🌟 Want to Experience the Latest Features?
- Patrons get **early access** to the latest builds.
- Join the **Community Cobblemon Server** to see new content before release.
